messages:
julia: rolling up monolith-40b-int4v1 to canary with extended-window support (64k). quick sanity passed but long-prefill goldset shows subtle divergence after ~49k tokens. posting logs and repro.

omar: can you paste the exact invocation and the failing token range?

julia: run command:
```bash
./run_onboard.sh --model=monolith-40b-int4v1 --mode=prefill --seq=52000 --prefill=50000 --quant=int4v1 --trace=kv,rotary
```
log excerpt (trimmed):
```
[2026-02-11T09:12:03Z] kv.write req_pos=50012 stored_pos=50012
[2026-02-11T09:12:03Z] kv.write req_pos=50081 stored_pos=17249
[2026-02-11T09:12:03Z] kv.read  req_pos=50081 served_pos=17249
[2026-02-11T09:12:03Z] rotary.apply pos=50081 used=17249
[2026-02-11T09:12:03Z] gen token="and" prob_delta=0.009
```

nina: stored_pos=17249 looks like aliasing (modulo) rather than clamp. could be SHARD_SZ or POS_MASK mismatch. which shard config was used?

julia: canary pool uses SHARD_SZ=65536, shards=4. this model was built with fast-kernel flag ENABLE_POS_16=false but i see in the build metadata that an older header sneaked in: POS_MASK=0x3FFF in one object file.

ravi: i ran a minimal C harness that mirrors the helper: global_pos -> shard_slot = (global_pos % SHARD_SZ) & POS_MASK; when POS_MASK=0x3FFF you get aliasing at 16384 boundaries, which matches other canaries we've seen.

omar: two simultaneous actions: 1) patch build to ensure POS_MASK uses 0xFFFFFFFF for 32-bit unsigned, 2) add unit test exercising indices around 16k/32k/48k/50k. I'll open PR.

nina: also add a runtime guard: if seq_len > 32k and kv.index.trace enabled, dump last 128 writes and reject silently if any served_pos != req_pos (fail-open only in dev). Helps CI catch regressions early.

ravi: small note: there's also an int4 kernel path that precomputes rotary cos/sin tables into a circular buffer sized with POS_MASK+1; if mask is wrong table wraps and uses wrong rotation for aliased positions. need to widen that allocation too.

julia: good catch. i'll coordinate kernel and runtime changes in a single PR set. can we also run a quant vs float diff after the fix to validate quality restored?

omar: yes. plan: land kernel + runtime fixes -> run canary on 3 nodes -> run goldset long-prefill (float32 vs int4v1 with same RNG seed) -> compute token-prob diffs and embed-ldeltas. if all diffs under threshold we promote.

ci-bot: CI started: onboard-monolith-4822468100 (patches: #8427 kernel, #8428 runtime, #8429 tests). Unit tests: kv-index-audit, rotary-buffer, long-prefill-smoke.

nina: temporary mitigation for traffic: enable kv.prefix-eviction for canary if prefill > 45k so we avoid writing high indices until patch lands. that will intentionally degrade very long prompt fidelity but keep correctness.

julia: doing that now on pool-canary-7. will re-run the failing goldset once CI is green. leaving traces on for 24h. @omar @ravi ping me if you find other breakage. :pray:
